metadata.title: Hamiltonian Cotangent Deformations of Space Forms: Curvature Pinching, Soliton Rigidity, Conjugate Loci, and Superintegrability
metadata.abstract: We study the one-parameter family of Riemannian metrics $g_\lambda$ induced by the Hamiltonian cotangent deformation $H_\lambda = H_0 + \frac{\lambda}{2}\|J\|^2$ on simply connected space forms of constant curvature $\kappa \in \{1, 0, -1\}$, where $J$ is the momentum map of the isotropy action fixing a base point. The master reciprocal identity $1/f_\lambda^2 = 1/s_\kappa^2 + \lambda$ governing the warping function controls the geometry of the family and implies that radial geodesic acceleration is independent of $\lambda$. From this mechanism we derive three classes of results: (1) Curvature and rigidity: closed-form sectional curvatures, the sharp positivity trichotomy, pointwise and global Brendle-Schoen $1/4$-pinching windows on $\mathbb{S}^{n+1}$, never-Einstein rigidity for $\lambda \neq 0$, and the realization of Hamilton's steady cigar soliton on $(\mathbb{H}^2, g_1)$ as the unique gradient Ricci soliton in the family. (2) Dynamics and stability: iso-kinematic decoupling into unperturbed radial motion and uniform precession $\Omega = \lambda L$, closed-form Clairaut integration, the transcendental inward conjugate point law with Euclidean inversion $r_0 R^* = 1/\lambda$, and stratified $A_3$ cusp caustics. (3) Integrability and spectral theory: maximal superintegrable rational pericenter invariants on $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$, transverse Killing rigidity on curved space forms, Fuchsian Heun spectral reduction with modulus $\tau = 1 + \lambda/\kappa$, and essential spectrum gap collapse to $[0, \infty)$ on $\mathbb{H}^{n+1}$. Extensions to anisotropic sphere families and intrinsic deformations of compact rank-one symmetric spaces ($\mathbb{C}P^n, \mathbb{H}P^n, \mathbb{O}P^2$) are also established.
metadata.comment: 56 pages, 2 tables. Dedicated to the memory of James J. Hebda

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 空间形式的Hamilton余切形变与曲率、动力学公式
analysis.workSummary: 研究由Hλ=H₀+λ||J||²/2诱导的单连通常曲率空间形式度量族，以1/fλ²=1/sκ²+λ的warping恒等式控制径向运动。作者推导截曲率和球面1/4-pinching窗口、非零形变的非Einstein结论及二维双曲模型中的cigar，另给进动、Clairaut积分、共轭点、积分不变量和谱约化。
analysis.breakthrough: 将同一显式形变机制用于曲率、动力稳定性、共轭轨迹与谱分析。
analysis.limitations: 摘要涵盖大量强断言，维数、λ使度量正定/完备的有效域及平凡Einstein参数例外须正文核对；不把soliton唯一性扩大到包括λ=0的全部空间形式。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 显式黎曼度量与可积动力学有用，但需逐项核对参数范围。
